purpose.domain_detail: Brazilian beverage/distribution logistics - Drop Size report (delivery route analysis by vehicle, driver, helper, sales manager, etc.)
purpose.summary: Program PW02130R generates a 'Drop Size' report for a Brazilian distribution/logistics system. It reads route map data (notas, pedidos, veículos, motoristas) and produces analytical or synthetic reports grouped by various dimensions (vehicle, driver, helper, sales manager, district manager, map, client, municipality). It is a CGI-based web report program using HTML preprocessing.

notable_features: $set preprocess (htmlpp) - HTML preprocessor for CGI web output
external-form CGI input section with 'identified by' HTML field names
64 COPY statements for modular file/record definitions
No COMP-3 usage despite financial calculations
Indexed file organization with lock mode manual
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars of a 153KB file (2686 lines). The program is clearly a production Brazilian distribution management system (likely PW/PC-series ERP). GnuCOBOL dialect confirmed by $set directives. Free-format source despite mechanical indicator saying 'fixed' - the $set sourceformat"free" directive overrides.
